summary: Iteration 2 tested new features: hardcoded auth (158/Rlpc_974), approval enforcement (403 without token), bill upload/download via Emergent object storage, and Safety Shoes purchase type. Backend: 41/41 pytest tests pass (10 new auth/bill/safety-shoes cases + all iteration-1 CRUD/filters/exports adapted to use auth token for approved records). Frontend E2E via Playwright: login dialog + 158/Rlpc_974 login works, header shows '158' + Logout, login persists across reload, logout clears session, approval checkbox is disabled with lock hint when logged out and enabled when logged in, Safety Shoes appears in form dropdown, bill file input works, creating a purchase with a PDF bill persists and the paperclip bill-link appears in the row. Cleaned up test data after each test.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth is a single hardcoded username/password from env — acceptable per user request but note there is no rate limit/lockout; anyone can brute force /api/auth/login. Consider adding basic rate limiting later.
JWT_SECRET is read from env at import time — good. Token lifetime is 7 days with no refresh/rotation.

PUT /api/purchases/{id} requires a full body (PurchaseBase, all fields required). This means every edit (even changing employee name) must resend approval flag, which is why the frontend also sends the token for edits. Considered non-blocking, matches product behavior.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers; migrate to lifespan.

Object storage init happens lazily and re-inits on 404 — good defensive pattern. If Emergent proxy is unavailable at boot, startup log warns but app still serves; bill upload/download endpoints will 500. Consider surfacing a friendlier error message from /purchases/upload-bill when storage init fails.
list_purchases returns bill_path/bill_filename inline as expected; the frontend paperclip is rendered as an <a href={billUrl(bill_path)}> and opens the file correctly.
test_credentials: Login: 158 / Rlpc_974 (single hardcoded user, JWT stored in localStorage as Bearer token).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed records (auth, bill, safety-shoes flows) and delete them via teardown. UI E2E created TEST_UI_BILL1 with a PDF bill and cleaned it up via the delete AlertDialog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split into /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (existing CRUD/filters/pagination/exports — approved-record creation now uses auth_session fixture) and /app/backend/tests/test_auth_bill.py (new: auth, approval enforcement 403/201, bill upload+download, Safety Shoes). Auth token comes from POST /api/auth/login {username:158, password:Rlpc_974}. Send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Frontend form testids: input-employee-id, input-employee-name, select-purchase-type, option-purchase-<value> (e.g. 'option-purchase-Safety Shoes'), select-payment-mode, option-mode-<value>, select-payment-by, option-by-<value>, checkbox-approved, approval-locked-hint, bill-file-input, bill-selected, submit-purchase-btn, cancel-form-btn. Table row paperclip: bill-link-<id>. Delete confirmation: confirm-delete-btn. Login: login-btn, login-username, login-password, submit-login-btn, logout-btn.
